name: Gnarlpine Corruption
summary: Near Starbreeze Village, Gnarlpine Corruption threatens Teldrassil. Wounded Great Warden Gaerolas Talvethren sends word to the night elf leadership in Dolanaar: Gnarlpine furbolgs have overrun the village and fallen to demonic corruption. Their violence may reach the sleeping druids of Ban'ethil Barrow Den.

sections.title: A Desperate Warning
sections.body: Near the ruins of Starbreeze Village, Gaerolas Talvethren lies grievously wounded after an ambush by his former allies. The Gnarlpine furbolgs were long regarded as peaceful neighbors and stewards of the wild, but now they have turned feral. Too injured to carry the warning himself, Gaerolas entrusts you with bringing word to Athridas Bearmantle in Dolanaar before the madness spreads farther through Teldrassil.

sections.title: The Scourge of Fel Moss
sections.body: In Dolanaar, Athridas Bearmantle learns the Gnarlpine furbolgs are being subjected to fel magic. Their chieftain, Ursal the Mauler, has harnessed the corrupted Fel Moss festering within the World Tree, driving his people into a violent frenzy. The tribe threatens settlements such as Starbreeze, and Ban'ethil Barrow Den lies nearby, where sleeping druids remain defenseless.

faq.answer: Gnarlpine furbolgs overran and pillaged Starbreeze Village after fel magic corrupted them. Their sudden ambush drove out or slaughtered the inhabitants, leaving Gaerolas Talvethren trapped and wounded near the village ruins.

faq.q: Why have the Gnarlpine furbolgs turned violent?
faq.answer: The Gnarlpine furbolgs have turned violent under their chieftain, Ursal the Mauler, who wields the evil power of Fel Moss found on Teldrassil. Its dark magic has driven the tribe into an uncontrollable frenzy against their former night elf allies.

Gaerolas Talvethren is the night elf Great Warden of the sleeping Druids of the Talon. Gnarlpine furbolgs ambushed him while he traveled toward Ban'ethil Barrow Den, and his wounds leave him relying on travelers to carry news of the catastrophe to Dolanaar.
Athridas Bearmantle is a prominent night elf authority stationed in Dolanaar. He oversees regional security and helps coordinate responses to threats against the World Tree and its inhabitants.

faq.q: Why are the night elves worried about Ban'ethil Barrow Den?
faq.answer: Ban'ethil Barrow Den holds many druids deep in the Emerald Dream. If the frenzied Gnarlpine furbolgs reach the barrows, the sleeping night elves will be defenseless against them.
Fel Moss is a corrupted growth in Teldrassil, tainted by dark demonic energies. Its influence drives local wildlife and furbolgs mad when touched or wielded.

angles.text: As a night elf, you face a tragic shock in Starbreeze Village's fall: even the newly grown World Tree is vulnerable to the demonic taint your people fought so hard to eradicate.
As a druid, you face an urgent threat to Ban'ethil Barrow Den and the Cenarion Circle, with sleeping brothers vulnerable to the corrupted Gnarlpine tribe.
